Two clients: help-carry, a join mid-ride lands in a seat, a join at a stop lands on the platform, pings and votes show on both; a screen recording of the train at cruise speed on the second client shows no jitter (else the decision 0018 fallback is raised at the checkpoint)
MicroProfiler: server frame time under 8 ms with 6 players, 34 wisps and a built stop; Device Emulator 844 x 390 at 30 fps or better at a stop and at night
Every GDD L line checked off in the notes
lune run tests/run, selene, stylua --check, validate-tasks and check-scope pass; rojo build lantern.project.json and check-place pass

evidence: Gates on every commit (ecfd5a9, c31e5a4, 5710ecf and the last): lune run tests/run 722/722 (tests/LanternAssets.spec.luau added: validate-tasks failed at 40abed7 because LANTERN-011 named it), selene src tests 0/0, stylua --check on LF copies clean, validate-tasks 94 valid, check-scope origin/main in scope, rojo build lantern.project.json + check-place match, garden.project.json builds and matches.

GDD K timed solo from PLAY in Studio, build 5710ecf (stamp shown in the corner and as [Build] 5710ecf in the server log), real controls (mouse on PLAY, STOKE, SIT, LAMP, the Depot vote; keyboard W and E to walk and pick up; the camera turned by script as a mouse would): train leaves 3.1 s, first stoke at about 6 s (speed 25, hint clears), stop 1 at 42.1 s, Moss Mouse crate picked at 48.1 s and loaded at 52.8 s (NEW! reveal, +10 Tickets +75 XP, level 2, the mouse rides in a passenger window). Stop 2 at 165.3 s on build c31e5a4 (same timings to stop 1). DataStores offline in the unpublished file, as expected.

Bugs fixed in Studio: (1) PLAY did nothing: ClientState.request sent a trailing nil that the kit's Payload counts, so play/stand/drop/stoke/mend were refused 'payload' with no toast; (2) Terrain.Decoration written from World crashed the server at boot (scripts lack the capability): now in lantern.project.json; (3) wisps drew 100x too big: LampFx.place called ScaleTo(1) on templates imported at scale 0.01; (4) a solo crew could never man a lamp at night (no seat UI while moving; lantern lost by wave 5): LAMP/STOKER swap button; (5) the turret could only be aimed by mouse look (trackpads; synthetic mouse gives no delta under LockCenter): arrows/WASD aim; (6) 'Tap to stoke!' never cleared; (7) the fog wall read as a lit white screen: fainter layers, no Neon edge, real shadow_wisp models inside; (8) stop tiles centred on the engine's front left half of each tile leading to empty track ahead of the engine: World.site at the train's middle, rear platform piece removed; (9) 'Full bunker for the run' shown at run end with 0 coal; (10) lamp heads were bare blocks: lamp_turret_head mesh welded on; plus the known stop frame (Site attribute), Carry help slot, audio ids, music crossfade, Future lighting and Neon glows.

Models: all 45 LanternAssets ids load in Studio (Models.nightReady for every id within a second of a preload); 17 client templates in ReplicatedStorage.LanternModels (critters, wisp, Lampeater parts; they import at scale 0.01). train_engine runs forward along the track (firebox and cab glow behind the middle, front at -Z); tile meshes sit on their blocks (raycast heights over the windmill tile's blocks 33/14/11/2/13/12/12/11 against block heights 44/15/13/3/14/13/12/12; the mirrored x positions miss), so the tile yaw is right; every _glow mesh is Neon (Ember on fire glows, Lamp Glow elsewhere); Lampeater wing_l at -11 x (its left), wing_r at +11.

Performance in Studio (one client, this PC): ride 59.7 fps, worst frame 18 ms, 1025 parts in Workspace; at a dressed stop 59.7 fps, worst 19 ms, 1121 parts; at night with wisps and four beams' worth of lights 60.0 fps, worst 18 ms, 1029 parts; Studio memory about 2.6 GB. Each dressed tile adds 7 to 9 decor meshes and a terrain patch.

Night with the real client: LAMP seats the player in turret1, arrows turn the lamp, Aim arrives at the server about 3 a second, 2 to 3 wisps puffed per night by the player's beam (stats.puffs credited, +2 XP each); Fx puff and dim both seen. Unpuffed, a solo night at DIM 6 ends 'lantern' by wave 5 (both full runs without the harness ended that way), end card 'The lantern went out'. Coal out on leg 2 (harness burn): coasted 11.7 s, end card 'The train ran out of coal, so the crew walked home', crew back at the hub, Depot +30 Tickets kept.

Look, against the art bible and popular Roblox co-op games (Dead Rails, 99 Nights, Grow a Garden's polish bar): the train, lamps, critters and the Depot read well and the palette holds (two temperatures, lilac fog, no black). Weak: dusk reads as night (no peach horizon: the skybox of art bible 3 is not built); every icon is a two-letter glyph (LanternIcons.luau does not exist yet); small items (sacks, cans) have no glow and sink into the grass blades, so they are hard to find at dusk; tiles are still open fields with 2 to 4 buildings; the fog bank is now soft but has a flat top edge and little rolling motion; the turret camera still shows the avatar's head; no wheel or chimney animation beyond smoke; no follower, item bob or squash on pick-up (GDD L lines not met); runtime warnings 'Asset content representation is being generated' for many new mesh ids (they rendered).
